title: Asian option valuation under price impact
abstract: arXiv:2512.07154v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a model for arithmetic and geometric Asian option valuation with external order flow and dealer execution costs. We first formulate it as a discrete model and then obtain its continuous time scaling limit. We derive an explicit geometric Asian option formula under a consistent price system and formulate the dealer's bid and ask through utility indifference with constrained stock trading. We identify sufficient conditions for finite reservation prices and prove absence of arbitrage under the dealer's stock trading rules. Increasing initial inventory lowers both the reservation bid and the ask in the cases studied. In the finite-step calculations, higher temporary costs and greater risk aversion widen the spread for both payoffs, with a smaller change in the midpoint of the quotes.

translated_title: 价格影响下的亚式期权估值
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个包含外部订单流和做市商执行成本的算术与几何亚式期权估值模型。我们首先将其表述为离散模型，随后得到其连续时间缩放极限。我们在一致价格体系下推导出显式的几何亚式期权定价公式，并通过带约束股票交易的效用无差异方法来表述做市商的买卖报价。我们识别出保留价格有限的充分条件，并证明在做市商的股票交易规则下不存在套利。在所研究的情形中，增加初始库存会同时降低保留买价和卖价。在有限步计算中，更高的临时成本和更强的风险厌恶会使两种收益形式下的价差扩大，而报价中点的变化较小。
tldr: 本文建立了一个考虑外部订单流与做市商执行成本的亚式期权估值模型，推导出一致价格体系下几何亚式期权的显式定价公式，并通过效用无差异方法给出做市商的买卖报价及无套利条件。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an Asian option valuation model incorporating external order flow and dealer execution costs, deriving an explicit geometric Asian option pricing formula under a consistent price system, with dealer bid-ask quotes obtained via utility indifference and absence of arbitrage proven under the dealer's trading rules.
